questions.stem: A 28-year-old male was involved in a high-speed road traffic accident. He reports severe pelvic pain and difficulty in passing urine. On examination, there is blood at the urethral meatus, and the patient complains of suprapubic tenderness. The bladder appears to be distended, and there is a high-riding prostate on a digital rectal examination. Which of the following investigations is the most appropriate to confirm the suspected injury of this patient?
